nodes.description: HArt.mint(address[] recipients, string[] messages) external payable: time-gated paid mint loop that calls _safeMint(recipients[i], nextToken()).
HArt.setBaseURI(string baseURI) external onlyOwner: writes the collection base URI.
HArt.withdrawETH() external onlyOwner: transfers the whole contract balance to owner().
HArt.isApprovedForAll(owner, operator) view override: checks OpenSea gas-free listing proxy or inherited operator approvals.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken() internal override ensureAvailability: derives a pseudo-random index from msg.sender/block fields and returns a token id.
WithLimitedSupply.availableTokenCount() view: totalSupply() - tokenCount().
WithLimitedSupply.totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply.
HArt._baseURI() internal view override: returns _BASE_URI_.
ERC721._safeMint(to, tokenId): mints then calls _checkOnERC721Received, performing an external call to the recipient contract.
HArt.price: per-token mint price (0.0069 ether).
HArt._BASE_URI_: base URI string returned by _baseURI().
WithLimitedSupply._tokenCount (Counters.Counter): number of tokens minted so far.
WithLimitedSupply._totalSupply: maximum number of tokens this collection can hold.
RandomlyAssigned.tokenMatrix: swap matrix used for random token id assignment.
RandomlyAssigned.startFrom: initial token id offset added to assigned values.
Ownable._owner: privileged owner address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address, used inside the randomness seed of nextToken.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time, used both as the mint gate and as a randomness seed.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received invoked from _safeMint via _checkOnERC721Received.
Pseudo-random index computation keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp)) % maxIndex.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance): value transfer out of the contract in withdrawETH.
recipients: calldata array of addresses receiving minted tokens in mint().
messages: calldata array of message strings used to compute mint cost in mint().
cost: accumulated ETH cost inside mint() based on price and message lengths.
i: loop index used in both mint() loops.
baseURI: calldata string parameter of setBaseURI().
owner: address parameter of isApprovedForAll().
operator: address parameter of isApprovedForAll().
maxIndex: totalSupply() - tokenCount() inside nextToken().
random: hashed modulo value used as the matrix index in nextToken().
value: resolved token matrix value returned (plus startFrom) by nextToken().

edges.reason: mint() calls _safeMint() which performs an external call to the token recipient.
_safeMint() reaches _checkOnERC721Received and calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
A malicious recipient can reenter mint() while the external onERC721Received callback executes.
mint() calls nextToken() to obtain each randomly assigned token id.
mint() is gated solely by a block.timestamp window check.
block.timestamp is used as part of the randomness seed, making the result miner-influenceable.
msg.sender is fed into the randomness seed of nextToken().
nextToken() computes a hashed value modulo maxIndex, a weak randomness derivation.
nextToken()'s ensureAvailability modifier calls availableTokenCount().
availableTokenCount() reads _totalSupply.
availableTokenCount() reads _tokenCount via tokenCount().
nextToken() reads and writes tokenMatrix for index swapping.
nextToken() adds startFrom to the resolved matrix value.
nextToken() increments _tokenCount through super.nextToken().
mint() reads price to accumulate the required ETH cost.
_baseURI() returns the _BASE_URI_ state variable.
setBaseURI() writes the _BASE_URI_ state variable.
withdrawETH() reads _owner to determine the transfer recipient.
withdrawETH() executes the payable transfer of the contract balance to the owner.
mint() calls availableTokenCount() to enforce supply availability.
recipients array is iterated in mint() to select mint targets.
messages array is iterated in mint() to compute cost.
cost local accumulates the required payment inside mint().
loop index i drives both loops in mint().
baseURI parameter is assigned to _BASE_URI_ in setBaseURI().
owner parameter is used in the approval lookup of isApprovedForAll().
operator parameter is used in the approval lookup of isApprovedForAll().
maxIndex local is computed and used as the modulus in nextToken().
random local indexes tokenMatrix in nextToken().
value local is returned (plus startFrom) by nextToken().

normalization_plan.reason: recipients is a calldata parameter used only inside mint() and should be folded into the mint function node.
messages is a calldata parameter used only inside mint() and should be folded into the mint function node.
cost is a purely local accumulator of mint() and should be folded into the mint function node.
loop index i exists only within mint() and should be folded into the mint function node.
baseURI is the sole parameter of setBaseURI() and should be folded into that function node.
owner is a parameter of isApprovedForAll() used only for the lookup and should be folded into that function node.
operator is a parameter of isApprovedForAll() used only for the lookup and should be folded into that function node.
maxIndex is a local computed inside nextToken() and should be folded into the nextToken function node.
random is the direct output of the keccak/modu randomness computation and should be folded into the randomness unsafe_operation.
value is a local resolved from tokenMatrix inside nextToken() and should be folded into the nextToken function node.
